method: Ran from the worktree at the base commit, in order: get-function-configuration for CodeSha256 (equal to the expected live value); get-function for the live zip (read-only) and sha256 check; make_candidate_map_perf.py wrote a candidate source map re-pinning only the two split member rows of the holdings function to the base commit; build-and-upload.sh BUILD_ONLY=1 ran twice with BAU_SOURCE_MAP_OVERRIDE; the two zips compared byte for byte; members compared by name and sha256 against the live zip; split markers counted at the pin.
notes: Live identity: CodeSha256 read by get-function-configuration equals the expected value and the downloaded zip hashes to it; the zip is in scratch outside the repository.
Not read or called: no put, delete, copy, invoke, publish, sign-in or vendor request; the two sibling functions were not built or downloaded, only named.
